corrections.text: The 'What We Don't Know' section states that cited sources do not give individual CVSS scores for the other 11 CVEs beyond SecurityOnline's aggregate 1-critical/10-high/1-medium breakdown. This is incorrect: SecurityOnline's article includes a 'Notable CVEs' table listing individual CVSS 3.1 scores for eight of those CVEs - CVE-2026-97033, -97034, -97035, -97036, -97037, -97038 and -97041 at 8.8, and CVE-2026-97040 at 9.8 - alongside their CWE types.

The Overview quotes freenode.net describing Go's practice as keeping 'details ... private until the releases land, in line with the project's security policy.' freenode.net's own About page does not name any editorial staff or masthead, and the article's byline is a pseudonym, so this attribution does not meet the Herald's reputable-source standard. The underlying characterization is independently consistent with the Go team's November 5 pre-announcement, which lists only CVE identifiers with no descriptions, but the quoted wording itself traces only to the unconfirmed outlet.
